claims.text: An earlier clinician note records no known drug allergies.
A later AI nurse consult summary states the patient developed a rash on day three of the course and is allergic to amoxicillin.

citations.quote: Patient developed a rash on day three of the course and is allergic to amoxicillin.

claims.text: The earlier clinician note records that blood pressure and weight were recorded, but gives no values.

open_questions: The record contains conflicting allergy information: an earlier clinician note (2026-05-02) states no known drug allergies, while a later AI nurse consult summary (2026-08-21) reports amoxicillin allergy with a rash on day three of the course. Which is current?
When was the amoxicillin allergy or rash first recorded, and what was the reaction and timing relative to the course?
What was amoxicillin prescribed for, and what course dates and dose were recorded?
Was any alternative antibiotic or allergy management plan documented after the rash?
What were the actual weight, blood pressure and other vitals, and were they repeated?
Were any follow-up appointments, referrals or tests planned, and were they completed?

candidate_highlights.risk_reason: A later note reports amoxicillin allergy with a rash, which conflicts with an earlier note documenting no known drug allergies.
candidate_highlights.suggested_action: Review the conflicting allergy entries and confirm the documented allergy status with the patient.
